headline: Indian stock market opens as Sensex and Nifty look to extend recovery after recent gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty recovered sharply as IT and FMCG sectors led a broad-based rally.
RBI intervention to supply daily dollar needs to state-run oil firms helped ease rupee pressure.
Analysts suggest markets may extend recovery after eight consecutive weeks of losses.
Overseas investors maintain long-term confidence in India despite capital outflow concerns.
whatHappening: Eight IPO issues are launching this week to raise over Rs 11,000 crore.
BSE Sensex rose over 800 to 1,000 points in recent sessions with all sectoral indices closing in the green.
Economists warn that pressure on the Indian rupee could persist following temporary relief from RBI measures.
SpaceX CEO Elon Musk stated that Starlink services in India must remain affordable.
summary: Indian equities enter the trading week looking to build on recent market gains driven by IT and broad sectoral strength. An intense IPO week is underway with multiple issues aiming to raise over Rs 11,000 crore. Meanwhile, currency pressures and global capital flows remain key factors monitored by market participants.
